description: Windows Server 2025, IIS, .NET/ASP.NET Core/EF Core 10 and PostgreSQL baseline.
compatibility_rules: .NET, ASP.NET Core and EF Core must use the same major version.
Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL must use the EF Core major and pass PostgreSQL integration tests.
IIS lifecycle inherits the pinned Windows Server build and enabled Web-Server feature manifest.
ASP.NET Core Module V2 hosting model and hosting bundle are validated together; in-process single-file deployment is not allowed.

constraints.deployment: Versioned, rollback-capable PowerShell/IIS deployment is owned by the application release Change, not this profile.
constraints.data_storage: PostgreSQL storage and service identity are outside the IIS application directory.
constraints.concurrency: IIS pool and PostgreSQL connection limits require project load evidence.
constraints.availability: Windows failover or multi-node topology is not implied by this profile.
constraints.backup: Database and IIS configuration backups are required before a production upgrade.
constraints.restore_drill: The application Change must prove database restore and previous release restoration.
